high_level_description: stc brand style, a close-up of a middle-aged man washing his hands in a modern bathroom sink with granite countertops.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A modern bathroom with a speckled gray and white granite countertop and backsplash, a chrome faucet, and a mirror reflecting the scene.

elements.desc: A bald man with neatly trimmed facial hair, wearing a crisp white long-sleeved shirt, leaning forward over a white porcelain sink.
A white paper towel dispenser mounted on the wall to the right of the sink.
